findings.body: `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` omits ignored files, while both `git diff` calls cover only tracked files. If Claude changes an ignored file such as `.env` and then fails, both snapshots match and Forge starts Codex despite the working tree having changed. The fallback guard must include those files.
findings.title: Not done: Sol high is the fallback

findings.body: This command-level test sets `workers = "codex"` throughout. Its ordinary-item check uses a fix, and its story-task check with a different route uses `repo = "forge-source"`. It never checks a non-user-facing story task in a client repo or a design task with `workers = "claude"`. Routing every client story task to design Claude, or using the ordinary Claude model for design work when workers is Claude, would pass the added test. Exercise both cases through `forge work`.
findings.title: Not done: client route matrix test

findings.body: The fallback test asserts only the default Codex model, then removes all model settings. It never sets `[models.design.codex]` to a different value, and its `turn/start` assertions count calls without checking the prompt against the brief sent to Claude. A fallback using a hard-coded model or sending an incomplete brief would pass. Assert the configured model and the outbound brief through `forge work`.
